title: The Corrections
author: Jonathan Franzen
summary: An ageing couple in the American Midwest hope to gather their three grown children for one last Christmas at home. Each child is dealing with a private mess, and the father's health is failing.
readIf: you like long, sharp family comedies that find the tragedy in everyday disappointments.
skipIf: you want sympathetic characters, since almost everyone here is difficult.

pairings.reason: Another big, comic and tragic American family novel with a streak of satire.
A tighter, more accessible look at suburban families and their buried tensions.
Offers a very different American family portrait, working-class and far more heart-on-sleeve.
